text:
Some properties of metal J are listed.
●
J does not react with cold water.
●
J reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid.
●
No reaction occurs when the oxide of J is heated with carbon.
What is J?
A
copper
B
iron
C
magnesium
D
sodium
subject: Chemistry
